llm_response.reason: The website shows multiple scam indicators: 1) Unusually low prices and zero transaction fee claims, 2) Promises of 100% deposit guarantee and exceptional trading speed, 3) Use of urgency-driven and promotional language, 4) Vague, unverifiable compliance references, 5) Mismatched/support emails and ambiguous customer privacy notation, 6) Domain registered recently (2025-07-30) with privacy protection, and 7) Celebrity endorsement and news-like updates to add artificial legitimacy. These match the described cryptocurrency scam characteristics. Legitimate exchanges do not use such tactics or hide ownership/company information.
